youtube_description: Here we go again--another annual visit to the Mendip Hills and the hike from Winscombe Church  upwards to Hill Farm on Cross Plain heading  eventually to the Trig point on Wavering Down and along its back to Crook Peak and then Loxton and  Bleadon Churches as will be shown in  other videos--a beautiful Summer's day...
